motionContract.intent: One small grounded joyful seated weight rebound, never airborne
motionContract.primaryMotion:
Animate this original compact seated Umi with ONE spontaneous little happy seated BOUNCE of weight, like a pleased small animal giving a quick buoyant body accent while staying seated. This is a GROUNDED chest-and-shoulder rebound, never a jump. The original paired short broad gray paws remain comfortably in contact at their original floor support, with both thick white forearms naturally bending to support the same small change of chest weight. His shoulders and upper chest gather a SMALL soft downward compression, then the head, neck, chest and shoulders spring lightly back into relaxed alert sitting as ONE quick elastic happy accent. The movement is modest and readable at ordinary everyday speed, the gather-and-rebound taking roughly half a second, then it finishes. Do not stretch the movement across the whole shot, demonstrate separate joints, lift the entire lower body, or hold any peak. Let a tiny pleased eye/cheek smile share the accent; the rest of the shot has easy grounded eye contact, one natural blink and relaxed breathing. Start and finish in the supplied original neutral seated support.

The compact lower seated root and BOTH original paws stay grounded throughout. Preserve the original head-body proportions, broad compact gray animal palms, short sturdy wrists and thick WHITE forearms with the exact original pointed white/gray boundary. Bent elbows accommodate the small chest press without lengthening the arms. Keep toes softly grouped and closed with the original tiny ivory nails; no reaching, paw display, sliding fingers, extra feet, new hind paws, long gray columns, standing torso, exposed long belly, image stretching, scaling or rigid whole-picture translation. The happy accent belongs to the supported head-neck-chest-shoulder body chain, never just wiggling the paws or nodding a detached head.

Preserve original face width, blue star eyes, continuous dark eyelid curves and separate gray bean brows. No broad talking mouth or new teeth. Keep the same viewer-left folded hard-cloth hood ear with its original X stitches and the other ear upright. ONE continuous heavy cape stays draped DOWN close to the seated root, with both narrow lower corners weighted downward even during the accent; never sideways wings, upward flung points, extra hem, skirt or sleeve panels. Only tiny scarf-tip and fold settling follows the small chest response, with no wind flourish.

The sole image is the original identity, materials, proportions and supported neutral pose, supplied as BOTH first and last frame. No airborne pose reference is used.
